metaDescription: Miniature Poodle vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Miniature Poodle boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Miniature Poodles: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Miniature Poodle series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class small does not invent new viruses for the Miniature Poodle, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final DA2PP / DHPP booster.
Flag legg-calve-perthes risk at Miniature Poodle vaccine checkups so the puppy’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Miniature Poodle series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Miniature Poodle shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or progressive retinal atrophy (pra) worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Miniature Poodle make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Miniature Poodle antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Miniature Poodle dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this small dog.
Reset the Miniature Poodle reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Miniature Poodle core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Miniature Poodle misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Miniature Poodle health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Miniature Poodle adult health guide for breed predispositions such as progressive retinal atrophy (pra), then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
